decisions.reason: As the flagship organic line closely aligned with existing charcuterie expertise and strategic direction, high absorptive capacity supports learning and retention.
The line remains close to core salami capabilities and is still supported with new variants, allowing the firm to interpret results and improve it.
Launched only in 2024 as an organic extension of familiar boiled sausage processing, it aligns with the organic direction and likely benefits from existing know-how.
The organic thinly sliced chicken line builds on established slicing and curing skills and has multiple models, giving high absorptive capacity to support its retention.
As an organic herb-coated salami close to core competencies, the firm can readily assimilate early results and improve it, making a drop unlikely.
